name: Strider
description: Massive walker that can load infantry inside, allowing them to attack with bonus range. Can enter Fortress Mode to provide an aura bonus. Attacks while moving. Heals units inside.

abilities.name: Fortress Mode
abilities.description:
Makes the Strider immoble and reduces incoming damage by {damagereduc}%.
Grant +{armor} Armor and +{damage} Damage to nearby units.
Can reinforce nearby.

abilities.name: Strider Mode
abilities.description: Return the strider to its mobile form.
